_comment: Hand-editable placement for gen_pcb.py.  x, y = centre of the footprint courtyard in mm
from the board's top-left corner (x right, y down); rot in degrees (KiCad sense, 90 turns
a vertical DIP horizontal, counter-clockwise on screen); side = top|bottom.  Parts not
listed are placed automatically next to the part named in their PcbNear schematic field
Every part here is placed with its SOCKET footprint.  Hand-placed
courtyards that collide are an error, not a warning (allow_overlap: true per part to accept
one).  checks.sockets demands a socket footprint for every DIP/PLCC part, checks.zif (optional) a
ZIF footprint for the listed refs.  A part may carry keepout: [[x0, y0, x1, y1, why], ...]
in footprint-local mm (unrotated, y down): each becomes a KiCad rule area that forbids
other footprints (DRC reports intruders) and that the auto-placer avoids.
Floorplan rev B: CPLD2 (I/O) left next to the connectors, DUART and AD724; CPLD1 (bus and
memory) right next to the SRAM pair (top right) and the two 74AHCT245 bus buffers; CPU
horizontal below both CPLDs; the two flash chips (rev 3: SST39SF040 in plain DIP-32 sockets,
no ZIF) side by side along the bottom edge under the CPU.
Edge connectors: J1 USB-C, J2 FTDI, J3 PS/2, J4 microSD on the left edge; J5 RCA and J6
audio on the bottom edge (left); J7 JTAG, J8 expansion, SW1 reset, SW2 NMI on the top edge.
J9 (logic analyzer, 2x15) on the top edge between the expansion header and the SRAMs; U8/U9 are SOIC-20 now, stacked between CPLD1 and the SRAMs; JP1 is gone (NTSC only).
